applies_to: Paragon Controls MicroTransEQ flow, velocity and pressure transmitters fitted with the BACnet communication board.
summary: The MicroTransEQ is a flow or pressure transmitter that talks BACnet MS/TP through an add-on communication board. It reports pressure, flow and temperature as Analog Inputs and exposes its alarm limits, delays and unit selections as writable values. Whether it works as a flow or a pressure transmitter is fixed in its setup (MSV 8, read-only).
notes: The manual gives each object as '<object type> <number> - <label>'; the label is used here as the object name.
Units of the process values follow the engineering-units multistate; they are not printed per object.
MSV 5 state text depends on MSV 8 / MSV 9 (flow, velocity or pressure); all three sets are given in the states field.
Device instance range 1,002 to 4,194,302 per the manual.

source.title: BACnet Communication Operation & Maintenance Manual (MicroTransEQ, MicroTransII, SPM-3000, SPM-4000)

integration.summary: Read AI 1 or AI 2 (depending on whether the unit is set up for pressure or flow) and the two alarm status multistates. If the unit should use a temperature from the BMS, set MSV 7 to Network and write AI 3.

minimum_points.name: Temperature
minimum_points.why: Temperature; BMS writes it when MSV 7 = Network

integration.remote_sensors: Temperature can come from the BMS: set MSV 7 Temperature Source to 3 (Network) and write AI 3.
setup: MS/TP MAC address 2-127, unique on each trunk; set at the device (see the device O&M).
Turn the BACnet terminator switch ON only on the two end devices of the trunk.
gotchas: MSV 5 state meanings change with the process type (flow, velocity or pressure).

points.name: Temperature
points.description: Temperature in use; writable for a network value
